name: growth-strategist
description: Route ambiguous growth problems to the right diagnostic, identify the binding constraint, and define the next evidence-backed decision.

name: growth-audit
description: Audit a product's growth system across measurement, market, acquisition, activation, retention, revenue, and execution.

name: customer-research
description: Turn interviews, support records, reviews, and behavioral evidence into ranked customer pains, triggers, objections, and decision criteria.

name: channel-fit-diagnostic
description: Choose acquisition channels by testing product, market, model, and channel fit before committing meaningful budget or time.

name: power-user-curve
description: Build L7 or L30 core-action histograms to measure engagement depth, identify power users, and compare cohort movement.

name: saas-unit-economics-audit
description: Audit SaaS unit economics by segment using gross-margin LTV, CAC, payback, retention, and sensitivity analysis.

name: growth-roadmap
description: Turn a diagnosed growth constraint into a focused quarterly plan with outcomes, experiments, owners, and decision rules.

name: offer-design
description: Design an offer by aligning the buyer outcome, mechanism, proof, risk reversal, price, and delivery constraints without fake urgency.

name: onboarding-activation
description: Design onboarding around a measurable activation event, shorten time to value, remove friction, and recover stalled users.

name: product-led-acquisition
description: Design product mechanics that expose value to non-users and create natural invitations, collaboration, or shareable outputs.

name: viral-loop
description: Measure, design, and improve product-embedded sharing loops using cohort attribution, step-level conversion, loop speed, and decay analysis.

name: retention-state
description: Design ethical value accrual that makes continued product use more useful through data, reputation, audience, graph, or workflow state.

name: experiment-design
description: Turn a growth hypothesis into a decision-ready experiment with one primary metric, guardrails, exposure rules, and a precommitted analysis plan.

name: marketing-loops
description: Turn a proven growth action into a safe recurring loop with explicit triggers, state, approvals, idempotency, monitoring, and stop conditions.

name: paid-media-creative-operations
description: Use when mapping approved ad copy and assets into live paid campaigns with protected controls, bounded changes, approval gates, and independent verification.

name: marketing-tagging-audits
description: Use when auditing paid-media tracking to verify live tags, consent, event pairing, attribution, and safe publication gates.

name: conversational-ads-optimization
description: Use when diagnosing conversational ad delivery, attribution, activation, landing-page fit, and cohort economics before changing campaigns or scaling spend.

name: paid-analysis-review
description: Use when reviewing paid-media reports, experiment results, or decks to verify metrics, reconcile attribution, and turn evidence into bounded decisions.

name: evidence-led-growth-audit
description: Use when a growth audit needs reconciled analytics and billing, traceable evidence, current source checks, and a verified final report.
